title: Loi sur les assureurs (Insurers Act)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre A-32.1 LOI SUR LES ASSUREURS'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: In force since 13 June 2019, replacing the former Loi sur les assurances; it governs insurers and their market conduct under the supervision of the Autorite des marches financiers. The insurance contract itself - proof of loss, payment of the indemnity, the insurer's obligations on a claim - is in the Civil Code of Quebec (CCQ-1991), arts. 2389-2628, not in this Act, which is a real structural difference from the Insurance Acts of the common-law provinces. Bodily injury from a road accident is compensated under the public no-fault scheme in the Loi sur l'assurance automobile, RLRQ c. A-25. A human should decide which of the three is the right anchor for this topic.
